status: [OPEN] Every value below is an editable placeholder. None is owner-approved and none is a Cloudflare limit. null means unknown (the check reports unknown, never ok).
note: limitBytes is the maximum size of ONE D1 database on the owner's Cloudflare plan. It is an owner fact (Cloudflare's published D1 limits page for the plan in use); this repository does not assume it. warnPercent and criticalPercent are shares of limitBytes. Per-table row limits are null until the owner sets them from a measured staging database.
